nodes.value:
SPECIFIC EFFECT AUTO-START GUIDE

WHAT THIS EXAMPLE DOES
- Watches for Speed I or higher.
- Starts this selected macro automatically when Speed first appears.
- Shows the detected effect ID, level, and remaining time.

IMPORTANT SETUP
- Keep this macro slot selected.
- Leave Auto set to Off. Event: Status Effect starts it by itself.
- Leave the macro stopped while waiting for the effect.

WHAT TO EDIT
1. Select the component named Speed Appears.
2. Effect ID is the exact Minecraft effect to watch for.
3. Minimum Level is the lowest accepted effect level.
   1 = level I, 2 = level II, 3 = level III.
4. Rename the component so its purpose is easy to remember.

COMMON EFFECT IDS
- minecraft:speed
- minecraft:strength
- minecraft:regeneration
- minecraft:haste
- minecraft:invisibility
- minecraft:poison
- minecraft:weakness
- minecraft:fire_resistance

The event triggers only when the effect changes from not matching to matching. Remove or let the effect expire before testing it again.

RUNTIME DATA
- ${effect.id} = full effect ID.
- ${effect.level} = displayed level starting at 1.
- ${effect.duration_ticks} = remaining game ticks.
- ${effect.duration_seconds} = remaining seconds.

Use Has Status Effect instead when a running macro only needs a true or false check.
